changelog: 🖱️ Click by sight — "click the Watch Demo button", "press the X", "scroll down". The vision model finds the element you named on screen and clicks it. He never clicks blind: if he can't find it, he says so and does nothing.
🤫 Looking is invisible — capturing the screen no longer makes a shutter sound or a white flash, so Jarvis can look without interrupting you.

📋 A Tasks window — installing software no longer freezes the conversation. It runs as a tracked background job, and a window shows who's working, on what, for how long, with a live progress bar. It opens itself when work starts and tidies away when it's done.

✅ Honest about his work — "how's the install going?" reads the real state of the job, never a guess, and he says when it's finished ("OBS Studio has finished installing"). A failure is announced as a failure.
❓ "Did you mean OBS Studio?" — a misheard app name becomes a question you confirm, not a silent swap and not invented progress.
🔗 Spoken web addresses open instead of searching — "open up the yggdrasilai.org website" goes to the site; filler words no longer knock a good address into a web search.
👁️ Jarvis wakes a blanked display before looking, instead of describing a black rectangle.
